messages.subject: DataTables Editor Extension in Shiny
parts:
I am interested in building a shiny app that pulls data from a mySQL database and then populates the data in a DataTable and simultaneously uses it to create a reactive chart. I would like to use the Editor extension of DataTables to allow the user to edit the data in the DataTable, which will then send the updated data to the shiny server, where I can then update the data used to generate the reactive plot.

Does anyone know how to properly initialize the editor extension in a shiny app?

Many thanks in advance.

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: DataTables Editor Extension in Shiny
parts:
Unfortunately, the DataTables Editor is not free, so we probably will
not support it in shiny. That said, editing tables without using the
Editor extension is something on the plan of the DT package
(http://rstudio.github.io/DT/).

Regards,
Yihui
